newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: EU 14 Oct distillate stocks rise 6.60 mln bls.
newsitem.headline: EU 14 Oct distillate stocks rise 6.60 mln bls.

text.p: Middle distillate stocks in the European Union, excluding Sweden, rose 6.60 million barrels, or 2.3 percent, in October to 291.45 million barrels, Stitching Euroilstock said in its latest monthly report.
The build still leaves stocks behind year-ago levels, but only by 21.65 million barrels, or 6.9 percent, compared with 33.47 million, or 10.6 percent, at the end of September.
Month-on-month, distillate stocks rose by 3.38 million barrels in France and by 1.50 million barrels in Germany.

Crude and oil product stocks rose by 6.23 million barrels, or 0.6 percent, in October to 1.012 billion barrels. This left them 42.92 million barrels, or 4.1 percent, lower than at the end of October 1995.
Crude oil stocks fell a mere 80,000 barrels to 401.06 million barrels.

Fuel oil stocks were 3.45 million barrels, or 2.5 percent, higher at 142.03 million barrels. This left a year-on-year shortfall of 6.55 million barrels, or 4.4 percent, this was 5.20 million barrels less than at the end of September.
Gasoline inventories fell 3.74 million barrels, or 2.4 percent, to 153.00 million barrels.
Naphtha stocks were stable at 24.64 million barrels.
Crude intake was 310,000 barrels per day (bpd) lower than in September at 11.009 million bpd, leading to a utilisation rate of 87.37 percent in October.
